hero_text: Reliable support for your home on the Costa Blanca — from key handovers and cleaning to regular checks and practical property care.
hero_label: A home looked after, wherever you are.
intro_title: Peace of mind for your place in the sun.
intro_text: Whether you visit for holidays or own a home here from abroad, having someone local to help makes all the difference. CostaCare brings together practical property assistance and attentive service, tailored to your needs.
services_kicker: WHAT WE CAN TAKE CARE OF
services_title: The details that keep your home cared for.
services_intro: Choose the support you need, from one-off help to regular visits and coordination.
s1_text: Regular visits to check the condition of your property and help spot issues early.
s2_text: Cleaning and getting your home ready before you arrive or after a stay.
s3_text: Practical help with access, key collection and arranging property visits.
s4_text: Help arranging local trades and coordinating small maintenance needs.
process_text: Every home and owner is different. We start with a conversation, agree the support you need and keep communication clear.
p1_text: Share the location and the kind of help you are looking for.
p2_text: We discuss the tasks, timing and a service plan that suits you.
p3_text: Receive updates about the agreed visits or tasks.
